body.p: In response to the Non-Final Office Action dated November 8, 2024 ("Office Action"), Applicant respectfully requests that the Examiner reconsider the above-captioned application in view of the foregoing amendments and the following remarks. Previously, Claims 2 1-32 were pending. By this Response, Claims 21 and 23-27 have been amended and Claims 22, 28, 29, 30, 31, and 32 have been cancelled without prejudice or disclaimer. Claims 33-35 have been added as new. Support for the amendments and new claims can be found throughout the application as filed, including but not limited to [0092]-[0097] and FIGS. 10A-10F of the application. Accordingly, Claims 21, 23-27, and 33-35 are pending. Status of the Claims

Claim 30 was rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112 as being allegedly indefinite. See Office Action, pg. 2. Without conceding the appropriateness of this rejection, Applicant has cancelled Claim 30, thereby rendering this rejection moot.

Applicant thanks Examiner Winakur for indicating that Claims 22-24 would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. See Office Action, pg. 4. Claims 21 and 28-32 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 102 as being allegedly anticipated by U.S. Pat. No. 9,192,330 to Lin et al. ("Lin"). See Office Action pages 2-3. Claims 25-27 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being allegedly unpatentable over Lin in view of US Pat. Pub. No. 2014/0275875 to Su et al. (hereinafter "Su"). See Office Action, pgs. 3-4.

Applicant respectfully traverses all of the above-listed rejections. However, in an effort to expedite prosecution of the present application, Applicant has amended Claim 21 as shown above to incorporate language similar to that which appeared in previously-pending Claim 22. Applicant has also made various minor amendments to Claims 23-27 and has added new Claims 33-35 as shown above. Applicant requests reconsideration of all of the pending claims in view of the amendments shown herein. Applicant respectfully submits that the rejections under @@ 102, 103 have been overcome.
Although the present communication may include alterations to the application or claims, or characterizations of claim scope or referenced art, Applicant is not conceding in this application

that previously pending claims are not patentable. Rather, any alterations or characterizations are being made to facilitate expeditious prosecution of this application. Applicant reserves the right to pursue at a later date any previously pending or other broader or narrower claims that capture any subject matter supported by the present disclosure, including subject matter found to be specifically disclaimed herein or by any prior prosecution. Accordingly, reviewers of this or any parent, child or related prosecution history shall not reasonably infer that Applicant has made any disclaimers or disavowals of any subject matter supported by the present application.

Aside from the present application, through standard continuation practice, Applicant has filed or may file additional applications that may have the same or similar supporting disclosure. Applicant requests Examiner review of the disclosure, claims, and prosecution history of such additional applications for any relevance to the present application, including review of, for example, any double patenting issues, pursuant to, inter alia, examination procedures in MPEP § 804. Please contact the undersigned to discuss any such issues
Please charge any additional fees, including any fees for additional extension of time, or credit overpayment to Deposit Account No. 11-1410.
